RMA stands for Return Merchandise Authorization — it's the process for sending a unit back if something's wrong with it. Every miner here comes with a free Harlo OS Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA line, so for three months after you get it, a faulty unit gets diagnosed and returned on us.

Anything else on the 40T?
Before you go, one thing: what made you ask about the RMA — anything about the 40T you're not sure will hold up?
Yes I am thinking of getting one.

Good call — the 40T is our best value per TH. $799, 40 TH/s, 650 W at the wall, ships November 30.

What do you pay for power per kWh? I'll run the sats and the monthly cost for you.
Yeah I think should get one sooner.
Searched the catalog · Hammer BC04 NerdOctaxe NerdQaxe in stock miner

If you don't want to wait on the November batch, the Hammer Thor P2 is in stock now — 10 TH/s, $369, about 166 W, ships within 5 business days. At 10¢ a kWh that's roughly $12 a month in power, and it's solo-drawing for a block every ten minutes from day one.

Want me to set that one up instead?
